text:
alex: Heads-up — ran into a hard limit when we tried to scale the new a100 nodepool in us-west2 for the training fleet. Autoscaler hit quota and kubelets started failing to schedule because pod IPs exhausted the secondary range.

maria: Ouch. Which quota specifically? GPU quota or IP address pool?

alex: Primary blocker is the VPC secondary range for the nodepool. Each node uses alias IPs for pods and we hit the 190/second-range limit on the subnet. Cloud console shows 'Secondary IP range is full' for the subnet attached to cluster-redwood-prod-usw2.

jonah: Did the nodes come up in a different subnet than expected? We recently provisioned a new subnet for a100-pool.

alex: They came up in a100-subnet-usw2, but the secondary-range we assigned is small (512 addresses). With max-pods default (~110) and burst scale to 8 nodes, we can exhaust it quickly.

maria: Can we reduce maxPods per node to 32 for that pool and rely on fewer pods/node? That would need kubelet config change and might impact throughput for our batch workloads.

jonah: Also the cloud project has a regional GPU quota that needs bumping — current limit is 16 A100s in us-west2, but planned training run needs 48. Filed a request but CSR said they need justification and subnet/IP headroom solved first.

alex: I'm drafting a single request for Cloud Support: increase A100 quota to 48 in us-west2 and expand secondary IP range for the a100-subnet from /23 to /22 (add +512 addresses). Also requesting increase of alias IPs per node if available.

maria: Sounds right. Alternate short-term mitigations:
- reduce maxPods to 32 for the a100 nodepool (kubelet arg)
- enable trunking on nodes (ENI trunking) to increase pod density per ENI if provider supports it
- migrate KV-heavy inference services to dedicated small instances to free up pod IPs

jonah: We should include the nodeTemplate and current gcloud commands output in the ticket. I grabbed relevant snippets: 

```
$ gcloud container node-pools describe a100-pool --cluster=prod-usw2 --zone=us-west2-a
config:
  machineType: a2-highgpu-1g
  diskSizeGb: 200
  maxPodsPerNode: 110
  oauthScopes: [ ... ]
networkConfig:
  podIpv4CidrBlock: 10.40.32.0/23
```

alex: And the autoscaler attempted to scale from 2 -> 8 nodes at 2025-11-02T22:13:00Z and failed with kubelet logs: 

```
Nov 02 22:13:12 node-7 kubelet[1789]: Failed to allocate pod IP: unable to find available secondary IPs in range 10.40.32.0/23
Nov 02 22:13:13 kubelet: eviction: node not ready, pods stuck Pending
```

maria: Add our cost note: expanding the subnet won't change GPU costs but increases address reservation. If Cloud asks for justification, mention steady-state expected pods and peak traffic for training windows (3x/day for 2h; expected peak pods ~220).

jonah: Also ask them to enable larger alias range or support CALICO custom CNI (if they require). If they push back, ask for temporary quota for preemption and fallback to lower-spec nodes.

alex: Drafting ticket now. Proposed text: 

"We are requesting a regional quota increase for A100 GPUs (from 16 -> 48) in us-west2 and an expansion of the VPC secondary IP range attached to cluster-redwood-prod-usw2 a100 nodepool from /23 to /22 to support projected pod density during scheduled training windows. Attached: nodepool config, kubelet logs, autoscaler events, and expected pod counts with justification. We will also temporarily reduce maxPods per node to 32 if subnet expansion will take longer than 48 hours."

sre-bot: @alex created ticket CLOUD-2320 for quota + subnet expansion request (link: https://cloud-support.example/CLOUD-2320) :ticket:

cloud-support: Thanks for the details, team. We see the subnet usage and the GPU quota request. Please provide expected steady-state and peak GPU utilization and confirm whether you need dedicated host reservations or preemptible VMs. Also confirm any preferred completion window.

maria: Replying to the ticket with metrics exported from prometheus: steady-state GPU utilization ~8 A100s, peak 48 A100s for 2 hours during nightly training; prefer completion within 72 hours, but can accept staged increases (24h for IP range, 72h for GPU quota).

jonah: Also asked infra to create a short-lived staging nodepool with an expanded /22 secondary range to validate the kubelet and autoscaler behaviour before we change prod. If staging looks good we'll flip traffic.

alex: Follow-ups:
- I'll change nodepool maxPods to 32 for a100-autoscale as immediate mitigation (rolling restart required).
- If cloud grants alias IP per node increases, we can revert maxPods later.
- Keep monitoring for orphaned ENIs: I found a script to detect stuck ENIs and will run weekly.

maria: Thanks. Once CLOUD-2320 moves we'll document rollback steps and a cost note to finance for the extra address reservation. :memo:

alex: Closing loop here — tagging @cloud-support once I attach the metrics and start the maxPods rollout.

sre-bot: Deployment scheduled: nodepool a100-autoscale maxPods -> 32 at 2025-11-03T01:00:00Z (rolling update). :gear:
